title: fix(app-shell): remove the ai:input config panel the palette never offered (objectui#8280)
body:
Fixes #8280
Clause-②: no

Carries out the ruling in comment 5810020464 on objectui#8280 (UI closure batch 5 item 5, letter **remove**). Dev session `https://claude.ai/code/session_014mXUNuFomfj24w7s1pZzhN`, dispatched by the `domain:ui` seat 2 claim, comment 5824651169.

## What changed

- **`previews/block-config.ts`**: removed `BLOCK_CONFIG['ai:input']` (the `agentName` and `placeholder` controls). The `ai` section comment now covers `ai:input` as well as `ai:chat_window`. The file header no longer gives a placeholder count, because this change would have made that count wrong. It now points at `block-config-i18n.test.ts`, which counts them.
- **`metadata-admin/i18n.ts`**: removed the three `ai:input` keys from both tables: `…field.ai:input.agentName`, `…placeholder.ai:input.agentName` and `…field.ai:input.placeholder`, in en and in zh, six rows in total. No other locale pack carries these keys. `git grep` for `ai:input` on the base found them only in this file.
- **`previews/__tests__/block-config.test.ts`**: removed `ai:input` from the "exposes a configurable panel" list. The case **"a block with a config panel is a block the palette offers"** now reads the palette itself (`TYPES_BY_CATEGORY`, built from `BLOCK_TYPE_META`). It used to keep only names in `specNames` before checking the palette, so every non-spec block without a palette entry was skipped. Objectui-native blocks (`object-grid`, `grid` and so on) still pass because the palette offers them, so they no longer need that exemption.
- **`previews/__tests__/block-config-schema-parity-8216.test.ts`**: removed the `ai:input` EXEMPT row (objectui#8281's bucket). The case "every exemption names a real block" fails on it once the panel is gone. The EXEMPT doc comment now records why the row was removed.
- **`inspectors/PageBlockInspector.i18n.test.tsx`** (H2 held): the zh-CN case "translates element:text and ai:input, the remaining prose sites" rendered `pageDraft('ai:input')` and asserted `智能体名称`. It now uses `element:button` and asserts its `icon` prose hint (`lucide 图标名` present, `lucide icon name` absent, `expectNoRawKeyPlaceholders()`). The assertion was moved, not deleted. No other case in the file asserts `element:button.icon`'s hint; the other `element:button` cases read its JSON literal and its parse error. The case name no longer claims to cover every remaining prose site.
- **`previews/__tests__/block-config-i18n.test.ts`**: ⚠️ **This file was not in the claim's file surface.** It pins the removed key and the counts that include it. The `EXPECTED` en sample had the `…placeholder.ai:input.agentName` row, and "every sampled key is one the table really reaches" fails on it once the key is gone. The exact pins `families.placeholder` and "collects all N placeholders" also counted it. They are now 17 total, 6 keyed and 11 literal, with a history note like the existing ones for objectui#3829 and objectui#7772. None of the 17 open PRs (read 2026-09-25 through REST, all file pages) touches this file.
- **`.changeset/8280-remove-ai-input-panel.md`**: `'@object-ui/app-shell': patch`.

No renderer or palette entry is added for `ai:input`. `PROTOCOL_COMPONENTS` in `@object-ui/components` and the CLI's `known-schema-types.ts` are unchanged.

## Premise check (on base `3335767b4`)

The card's claims held: `ai:input` is not a `BlockTypeId` or a `BLOCK_TYPE_META` row, it is not in `PALETTE_EXCLUSIONS`, and it is not a `PageComponentType`. The card counted "four translation entries". The actual count is three keys in each locale, six rows in all.

## Ablation (fix committed first at `0fd05e1`; mutations applied and restored with `ablation-replace.mjs`)

- **Leg A** re-adds the `ai:input` panel to `block-config.ts`. The tool confirmed the change was on disk (anchor count 1 to 0, blob `ce23c9e4be50` to `bbc867e2bd2f`, `PLANTED-ENTRY-COUNT=1`). `block-config.test.ts` then had **1 failed, 42 passed**. The one failure was "a block with a config panel is a block the palette offers", with `expected [ 'ai:input' ] to deeply equal []`. After the restore the blob matched HEAD and `git diff HEAD` was empty.
- **Leg B (control)** used the same planted panel plus the old `specNames.includes(t)` filter (`OLD-FILTER-COUNT=1`). The same case **passed** (1 passed, 42 skipped). So the old filter did skip this shape. Both files were restored to their HEAD blobs.
- My first try at Leg A was refused before anything ran: its replacement contained its own anchor, so the anchor count could not drop. No test ran on that try. I changed the anchor and ran it again.

## Verification (all at HEAD `0fd05e1`)

- The 9 test files that read `BLOCK_CONFIG` or `blockHasConfig`: **9 files, 132 tests passed**. These are block-config, block-config-i18n, schema-parity-8216, PageBlockInspector i18n, retiredBlockProps and sectionName, definition-list-item-keys-8279, page-tabs-item-value-8278 and form-preview. H3 held: the stricter case found no other orphan panel.
- The full `@object-ui/app-shell` suite (`pnpm exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 packages/app-shell/`, run under the shared verify lock) **passed**: "Test Files  775 passed | 1 skipped (776)", "Tests  7661 passed | 9 skipped (7670)", lock VERDICT command-exit 0.
- `@object-ui/app-shell` type-check (`tsc --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`) passed after building the dependency closure `@object-ui/app-shell^...` (build exit 0, type-check exit 0). `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json --listFiles` lists all 4 changed test files.
- Gates, each exit 0: `check-changeset-presence` ("6 source file(s) of 1 released package(s) changed, and this change declares 1 changeset(s)"), `changeset:check`, `check:changeset-claims`, `check:pending-changeset-literals`, `check:i18n-keys`, `check:i18n-dead-keys`, `check:i18n-drift` ("3 removed — those are check:i18n-designer-parity's"), `check:i18n-designer-parity` ("Every en row has a zh row"), `check:designer-field-key-parity`, `check:new-line-citations` ("VERDICT new-cross-file-line-citations: 0 new citation(s)"), `check:control-bytes` and `check:test-path-roots`. `check:changeset-claims` listed 6 pending changesets that name files touched here. I re-read each quoted paragraph, and all of them are still true after this change.
- Lint was not run repo-wide; `pnpm lint` stays with CI. I ran `eslint --no-inline-config --format json` on the 6 changed lintable files. It reported 6 files, 0 errors and 6 warnings, all `no-explicit-any` on unchanged lines (the diff adds or removes no `any`). Every file appears in eslint's JSON output. No config is type-aware: `eslint.config.js` sets no `parserOptions.project` or `projectService`, and no `eslint-rules/` rule reads other files. So this diff cannot change the lint result for any file it does not touch.

## Acceptance notes

- **Two stale comment counts, not changed here.** Both files were touched by this change, but the counts were already wrong on base: 11 literal placeholders, not 10. One is the #3979 describe comment in `PageBlockInspector.i18n.test.tsx` ("Ten of the seventeen placeholders are example VALUES"). The other is the literal-side describe comment in `block-config-i18n.test.ts` ("ten English-looking strings remain"). The counted instrument is that file's "collects all N placeholders" case. Nobody is lined up to pick these up; I recorded them here and did not file a card.
- The historical `ai:input` mention in `packages/app-shell/CHANGELOG.md` is left as it is, because it is release history.
- objectui#8281 and objectui#8279 stay open; this PR does not touch either card's own work.
